architecture: MobileNetV3-Small shared encoder + U-Net ROI segmentation + 9-class classification
checkpoint: best_model.pth (training artifact; not required by the static web app)

preprocessing.cccd: When preliminary RGB classification predicts CCCD, rerun segmentation/classification with grayscale page and ROI replicated to RGB tensor; no thresholding.

outputs.embedding_prototypes: prototypes.json; normalized 576D class means; compare with cosine similarity

rejection: Prototype similarities can rank similarity to known documents. A reliable unknown/non-document rejection threshold needs dog/cat and other negative samples.

validation.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU
